user.title: Connect Gemmy Orchestra of Lights Hub
user.description: Enter your Hub's 12-character MAC address / Hub ID (shown in your router as 'espressif' or in the app under Hub Info). Local IP is optional—in 'auto' mode, direct LAN TCP port 8087 is tried first with automatic fallback to AWS IoT MQTT.

data.host: Local IP Address (optional, for LAN TCP 8087)

error.invalid_hub_id: Enter a valid 12-character hex MAC address / Hub ID.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the hub. Check the Hub ID, IP address, and that the hub is powered on.

abort.already_configured: This Orchestra of Lights Hub is already configured.
